Who is Mmms?

Tssr (Son) Br (Son) Betty (Daughter) Celia (Daugther) Unnamed Inbred grandchildren}}Mmms, is a Velociraptor mom, first mentioned by name iVn the comic Raptors Hijack: The Wild.

Her five children are Alf, Betty, and Celia, and the deceased Tssr and Br.

Several days after the incident at Jurassic Park, Alan Grant, and Ellie Sattler our brought back to Isla Nublar as animal consultants as the military tries to find and round up the remaining dinosaurs. After a successful capture of the tyrannosaur, there is a discussion as to whether there are still Raptors remaining out in the park. The military believed that all animals were killed while Grant and Ellie believes that they perhaps have a nest hidden off somewhere.

A poacher by the name of George Lawalla, follows the two into a cave, where a mother raptor and five chicks (three male and two female) have nestled. The mother attacked the three humans and put a particular pursuit on Lawalla, of whom kills the mother and steals the infants along with a kidnapped, Alan Grant, and Ellie Sattler. Notes:
